title: Thinking with portals: split live HTML across Blue and Orange portals
blurb: Drag or fling live HTML form cards halfway through a Blue portal on one 2D canvas and watch them emerge out of an angled Orange portal with momentum preserved and working controls on both halves.
question: Can one live interactive HTML element pass halfway through a Blue portal and emerge simultaneously out of an angled Orange portal on a 2D canvas with momentum preserved and working controls on both halves?
result: Not verified in Chromium yet. Six isolated live checks test simultaneous split-clip drawing from one element, angled exit rotation, last-draw-wins hit-box routing, momentum vector rotation, live DOM repainting on both halves and context survival on your device.
